# splines.types: CatmullRomCurve2D

**Status:** Supported (tier `geometry`). In a shipping tier; the lint, type-check, and code-generation gates cover it. No release promises its signature yet.

## Summary

> A Catmull-Rom spline in the plane: interpolates every point with tangents
> derived from neighbors. Alpha selects the parameterization: 0 = uniform,
> 0.5 = centripetal (cusp-free), 1 = chordal
> (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centripetal\_Catmull%E2%80%93Rom\_spline).

## Signature

type CatmullRomCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
```

//==
// # Interpolating splines
//
// The control-point curves that pass THROUGH every point they are given, with
// tangents derived from the neighbours (Catmull-Rom), shaped per knot
// (Kochanek-Bartels), absent (piecewise linear), or solved for globally (natural
// cubic). Parallel arrays must have equal counts; that invariant is documented
// rather than encoded. Evaluation lives in
// `splines.library.plato`.

//==
// # Interpolating splines

// A Catmull-Rom spline in the plane: interpolates every point with tangents
// derived from neighbors. Alpha selects the parameterization: 0 = uniform,
// 0.5 = centripetal (cusp-free), 1 = chordal
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Centripetal_Catmull%E2%80%93Rom_spline).
type CatmullRomCurve2D
    implements ICurve2D, IDeformable2D
{
    Points: Array<Point2D>;
    Alpha: Number;
    Closed: Boolean;
}
```
